page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head centred at top, printed page number at top left. Catchword "in" at bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: uo filio, mortuo iam nepote, cuius u-xor praegnans esset, testamentum avus faceret: quo casu non dicet, SI FILIVS MORIATVR, TVNC QVI NEPOS, vt in Aquiliana formula. Quo igitur modo? TVNC QVI PRONEPOS. Quid vero si & filius & nepos viuant, nepotis autem uxor sit grauida, cuius filio sit prospiciendum: quid cum filij? non enim ex Aquiliana formula testator dicet, FILIVS HERES ESTO, SI FILIVS MORIATVR, TVNC QVI NEPOS. sed, FILIVS HERES ESTO, SI FILIVS ET NEPOS ME VIVO MORIANTVR, TVNC QVI PRONEPOS. Nunc, inquit Scaevola, & filius & nepos viuant, concipere ita poterit testator, SI VTERQVE VIVO ME MORIATVR, TVNC QVI PRONEPOS NASCETVR, &c. Quae dubitatio quia puero potius, quam iurisconsulto, digna est, idcirco verbo uno similiter hanc quoque formulam admittendam esse respondet, ualiturámq;[?] pronepotis institutione: ita tamen, si prius nepos, dein de filius decesserit; ne, si nepos mortui in

page.notes: The word "uo" at the top is a fragment of a word broken from the previous page (probably "auo"/"auo" cut at the line end), kept as printed. The line-end mark after "u" in "cuius u-xor" is read as a hyphen. The abbreviation after "ualitura" is read as -mq; with a doubt, marked [?]. Old-style page number read as 160.
